name: warp_change
title: Locations where the period distance changes.

origin.description: Returns the 1-based positions that bound a change in warp_distance.
origin.usage: warp_change(x, period, ..., every = 1L, origin = NULL, last = TRUE, endpoint = FALSE)

arguments.name: last
arguments.text: TRUE returns the last position before each change, and always includes the end. FALSE returns the first position of each group, and always includes the start.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.text: When last is TRUE, also include the first position if the first two distances match. When last is FALSE, also include the last position if the last two match.

origin.details: The scan compares distances. A missing distance equals another missing distance and does not equal a number. A length-1 vector returns 1. An empty vector stays empty.

translation.description: Returns the 1-based positions that bound a change in warp_distance.
translation.usage: warp_change(x, period, every=1, origin=None, last=True, endpoint=False)

arguments.name: last
arguments.text: True keeps the last row of each group. False keeps the first.

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.text: Also keep the opposite end when the two distances there are equal.

translation.details: NaN distances compare equal to each other. The positions are 1-based, matching R.
translation.value: A float64 NumPy array of positions.
